summary: Structural twin of 00599232: reads a delegate pointer at this+0x50; returns 0 if it is NULL or the delegate call sub_59BB00(v4, a2, 0, 2*a3) reports failure, otherwise returns this. Differs only in doubling a3 before the call.

local_names.a2: first argument forwarded to the delegate
local_names.a3: argument doubled (2*a3) before being forwarded to the delegate

operations.description: v4 loaded from this[20] (delegate pointer at offset this+0x50).
If v4 is NULL, function returns 0 immediately without calling the delegate.
a3 scaled by 2 before being forwarded to the delegate call.
Delegate sub_59BB00 invoked with (v4, a2, 0, 2*a3); a constant 0 is passed as third argument.
If sub_59BB00 returns non-zero (failure), function returns 0.
Returns this on success, 0 when the delegate is NULL or the delegate call fails.

unresolved: Whether this is truly locale/encoding related (per cluster-copy prelabel) is unverified; only the 2*a3 argument scaling distinguishes it from 00599232.
Semantics of sub_59BB00's return value and the meaning of its constant 0 argument are unknown.
The object type owning the delegate pointer at this+0x50 is unidentified.
